lastText: The Work CollapsesFull ExposureNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 15MOB STORMS CASTLE'S WEST TOWERThere is no bribe left to pay and no story left to tell. The magistrate arrives with the mob a half-step behind him, torches already lit.
